---
name: review-drift
description: Review a diff for contract, test, tooling, and documentation drift
---

Read the changed code, normative contracts, test strategy, and applicable task
card. Report concrete findings with file location, violated contract, impact,
and smallest correction.

Check service ownership, malformed/error paths, arithmetic, public docs,
secrets, duplicated automation, implicit targets, unbounded operations,
rollback, focused tests, and separate platform/workflow evidence. Tests are
evidence, not a substitute for contract review.
